description: This file contains unit tests for WebSocket JSON communication in the Thunder project, including classes for message handling, WebSocket server and client implementations, and a test case that verifies WebSocket JSON message exchange.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: A JSON container class representing a message with 'eventType' and 'event' fields.

classes.name: Factory
classes.description: A pool of Message objects used for WebSocket message handling.

classes.name: JsonSocketServer
classes.description: A templated class implementing a WebSocket server that handles JSON messages, with synchronization primitives for state management.

classes.name: JsonSocketClient
classes.description: A templated class implementing a WebSocket client that sends and receives JSON messages, with methods for retrieving message data.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Returns true indicating the server or client is idle.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events, notifying waiting threads.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends JSON messages (empty implementation in this test).

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the static state indicating if the server is active.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the last received message text.
